reader.requirement: At --std 85 every argument of FUNCTION VARIANCE must be class numeric, i.e. an arithmetic expression (§1989:A.2.2 type (1)): a numeric item, numeric literal, ZERO, a numeric/integer function or an expression is accepted (including a table(ALL) argument over an ODO table), and an alphanumeric, alphabetic, numeric-edited, group, nonnumeric-literal, non-ZERO figurative, alphanumeric-function or index operand is refused.

ArgPredicate.AppliesAt(edition year); VARIANCE's row has no predicate, only the class kind 'n', screened identically at every edition
ConstructRegistry numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: at 85 a numeric function written where an identifier stands (MOVE source) is refused COBOL0900; at 2002+ admitted

reader.edition-search: grep of IntrinsicBinder.cs for Edition/DialectLevel/ConstructRegistry/DialectBehavior; IntrinsicArgumentRules ArgPredicate.Since; the class screen itself carries no edition switch

reader.notes: The catalog row VARIANCE 'n' is screened by the spec-verified table through IntrinsicArgumentRules.Violation, the same code at every edition; 1985's 'class numeric' (arithmetic expression) and 2023's coincide for every operand 85 can write. Diagnostic texts cite §2023 clauses rather than §1989 ones, a wording matter only.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-213/src: xvar1.cob (admit half the reader did not try) prints V-P1= 010000.000000 for VARIANCE (P1 0) with P1 PIC 9PP = 200, V-P2= 000000.000004 for a PIC SVPP9 item and ZEROES, V-C1S1= 000006.222222 for a COMP item, a SIGN LEADING SEPARATE item and ZEROS, V-SIGNED= 000009.000000 for (+3 -3): all correct. xvar2.cob: COBOL1627 for a reference-modified numeric item N (1:2) (category alphanumeric at 85), HIGH-VALUE, QUOTE, LOW-VALUES, ALL "1", an alphanumeric table TX (ALL), a GROUP table GE (ALL), a numeric-edited table ED (ALL) and FUNCTION CHAR as argument. xvar3.cob: COBOL0844 for an alphanumeric operand inside an argument expression (N + X), COBOL1627 for REVERSE and SPACES as argument-2. cite.py: OK  §1989:A.2.45.3 AR1  (2.45.3 Arguments)  the text is in AR1; OK  §1989:A.2.2  (2.2 ARGUMENTS**)  the text is in the clause; it lies in AR1. The class screen has no 1985-only arm and the 1985 definition of class numeric (arithmetic expression; ZERO allowed per §1985:VI.6.2.3) coincides with what the screen admits. The juxtaposed parenthesised argument VARIANCE (A (- B)) is refused by the grammar (kb/Work PB5781, open), a parse of the argument list rather than the class screen this rule governs; it is charged to the format rows (see 1989-FMT-A.2.37.2 in this file).
